scope: Actual separate CLI invocations, owned session processes and the paired playground API share real parsed public pages and explicit extended-SafeJS evaluations. Public requests are read-only GETs; canceled links make no remote mutations. Website-authored scripts are not automatically loaded. This is not a visual playground UI test. Credentials, raw responses and script results are not retained.
